Run: 700 tests total, 698 passed, 2 failed. Both failures in same file: auth/tokens.test.js.

Failed:
1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — auth/tokens.test.js:400
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — auth/tokens.test.js:650

Both look like real bugs (token revocation not enforced, DB rollback leaving orphans), not flaky infra noise. Worth fix before next deploy.
